name: Le Nonne & Jack's Wood Fired Oven (Logan) Homemade Gnocchi/Fettuccine & Margherita Pizza
brandOrRestaurant: Le Nonne / Jack's Wood Fired Oven (Downtown Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Authentic downtown Logan Italian kitchens using 00-flour dough and handmade potato gnocchi or egg fettuccine that digest much cleaner than heavy American chain pasta.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At Le Nonne, order handmade potato gnocchi or fettuccine with light butter/olive oil, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and grilled chicken/salmon; at Jack's, order a light-cheese Margherita or Prosciutto wood-fired pizza.
watchOuts: Ask for light garlic and take a Lactaid if ordering cream/mozzarella dishes
